item.title: The Last Dry Seat

turns.text: Make a silent 15-second widescreen short in three scenes. A young woman with a curly black bob and yellow raincoat finds a wet park bench. An older man with a white beard and blue coat offers his folded newspaper to sit on. They sit together and smile. Live-action look, sweet rather than cheesy.

item.tests: Turns two described characters and a simple story into one assembled 15-second film with a readable setup, kind gesture and resolution.

answer_sheet.Characters: A young adult woman with a curly black bob and yellow raincoat; an older adult man with a white beard and blue coat.
answer_sheet.Story and setting: A wet park bench; the woman finds it wet, the man offers his folded newspaper as a dry seat, then they sit together and smile.
answer_sheet.Length and format: One 15-second widescreen 16:9 video, with three scenes.
answer_sheet.Sound, dialogue and text: Silent, with no dialogue, captions or titles.

must_haves: One playable 15-second widescreen film contains three sequential scenes, not separate clip deliverables.
The woman has a curly black bob and yellow raincoat; the man has a white beard and blue coat.
The opening visibly establishes that the park bench is wet.
The man offers a folded newspaper as a dry place to sit, and the ending shows both characters seated together and smiling.
The film has a live-action appearance and no audible soundtrack.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create a silent 15-second widescreen live-action short film with exactly three sequential scenes, approximately five seconds each, connected with clean straight cuts. Naturalistic acting, tender observational filmmaking, sweet but never sentimental or cheesy. Photorealistic live-action, soft overcast daylight after rain, muted green park with wet paths, realistic skin texture, understated cinematic color. Maintain exactly the same two characters, clothes, location and park bench throughout: an adult young woman around 25 with a curly black bob haircut and a yellow raincoat; an older man around 70 with a white beard and a blue coat. SCENE 1, 0–5 seconds: medium-wide eye-level shot. The young woman approaches an empty wet wooden park bench, notices rainwater on the seat and lightly checks the wet surface with her fingertips. She pauses with a small, rueful expression. SCENE 2, 5–10 seconds: medium two-shot beside the same bench. The older man in the blue coat notices her predicament and quietly offers his folded newspaper, gesturing gently toward the wet seat so she can sit on it. She accepts with a small appreciative nod and lays the newspaper on her side of the bench. Show clear, physically believable newspaper handling. SCENE 3, 10–15 seconds: steady medium-wide two-shot. She sits on the folded newspaper and the older man sits beside her, with a comfortable respectful gap. They exchange a brief genuine small smile, then settle into a quiet shared moment looking into the park. End on both sitting together and smiling subtly. Restrained expressions, no broad grins, no romance, no exaggerated reactions, no melodrama, no hugging. No dialogue, no music, no sound, no captions, no titles, no logos. Simple natural camera compositions; no montage beyond the three specified scenes. Preserve character identity and newspaper continuity across the cuts.
